`final class ImageUtils`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.utils.image` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ImageUtils.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/utils/image/ImageUtils.java)

Decodes an image with a chosen reader and prepares pixels with transparent areas for filtering.

## Description

The image decoders of JOID use it; a decoder of your own can too.

- [Custom formats](/use/learn/going-further/custom-formats/)

## Method details

<a id="ImageUtils-method-read"></a>

### read

`BufferedImage read(InputStream stream, ImageReaderSpi spi)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Decodes the first image of `stream` with the ImageIO reader of `spi`.
Throws an `IOException` when the stream cannot be read or decoded.

<a id="ImageUtils-method-bleedAlpha"></a>

### bleedAlpha

`void bleedAlpha(int[] pixels, int width, int height)` <span class="joid-qualifier">static</span>

Gives each fully transparent pixel of `pixels` (ARGB, `width` × `height`, row after row) the color of the nearest pixel that is not, and keeps its alpha at `0`.
A filtered texture then shows no dark fringe around its transparent areas; an image fully opaque or fully transparent stays unchanged.
